jobs.occupation: AI Implementation Intern with specific focus on AI adoption in European HR M/W/X
jobs.description:
This internship offers a unique opportunity to explore how Artificial Intelligence can enhance HR, Recruitment, Learning & Development, and other people-related functions by identifying opportunities for process optimisation, automation, and improved employee experience.

 

• Analyse business processes across People & Culture, Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development, and related people functions to identify opportunities for AI adoption and process optimisation.
• Research AI tools, technologies and emerging solutions applicable to people-related business processes.
• Evaluate existing workflows and identify opportunities for automation, improved efficiency and enhanced employee experience.
• Benchmark industry best practices and AI use cases across HR and People functions.
• Develop recommendations for AI implementation, including suitable technologies, expected business impact and implementation considerations.
• Assess organisational readiness, transformation anticipated risks, required capabilities and change management considerations for AI adoption.
• Collaborate with HR, People and Culture Director and business stakeholders to validate opportunities and prioritise initiatives.
• Present findings, business cases and implementation roadmaps to project stakeholders. 
• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's programme in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, AI, Computer Science, Data Science, ICT Management, Information Systems, or a related field.
• Strong interest in the practical application of Artificial Intelligence within business functions, particularly HR, Recruitment, and People Operations.
• Good understanding of current AI technologies, including generative AI, automation, workflow optimisation, or intelligent process improvement.
• Analytical mindset with the ability to map business processes and identify opportunities for increased efficiency.
• Excellent research and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate findings into practical recommendations.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
• Knowledge of German, French and/or Dutch is considered a strong advantage.
• Previous exposure to AI tools (e.g. Claude, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Microsoft Power Platform, automation platforms, or similar technologies) is an asset.
• Candidates with a combination of HR knowledge and AI/technology expertise are particularly encouraged to apply.

This large Belgian organization manages a technically complex and business-critical network where operational safety, real-time communication and system reliability are essential. Behind the scenes, several digital platforms support field operations, control rooms and operational staff in managing safety-critical processes.
Within this context, one of the core applications is evolving from a single solution into a broader ecosystem of applications focused on the safety of real-time operations. To support this evolution, the organization is looking for an experienced Architect who can bring structure, technical vision and architectural leadership to the team.

Jobomschrijving

You will define and guide the technical architecture of a growing application ecosystem used in safety-critical operational processes. You will work closely with developers, analysts, product stakeholders and technical teams to ensure that new and existing solutions are scalable, reliable and future-proof.
You will use your expertise to assess current implementations, propose improvements and help shape upcoming developments. You will coach developers, promote best practices and ensure that architectural decisions are translated into clean, maintainable and robust solutions.
You will also proactively identify technical risks, challenge implementation choices where needed and ensure that quality, scope and deadlines remain aligned. Because the applications support real-time operational workflows, performance, stability and clear communication are crucial throughout your mission.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with .NET
• Experience as Architect / Senior Analyst
• Knowledge of Angular
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

As Chief Project Officer, you will lead our complete project portfolio in the Benelux and across Europe. You will manage three direct reports and take responsibility for a multidisciplinary project organisation of approximately 15 employees across BIM, work preparation, project management, site management, automation and part of the validation activities. You will create the structure, standards and leadership needed to support continued growth.

You will get to know our customers, markets and ADAPTUS platform (our modular platform for standardised, scalable cleanroom solutions) inside out.

Your responsibilities include:

•Taking final responsibility for projects from design and execution through to delivery

•Leading, coaching and developing three direct reports and the wider multidisciplinary project organisation of approximately 15 employees

•Acting as a technical sparring partner on complex HVAC and cleanroom challenges

•Safeguarding margins, planning, quality and performance across the project portfolio

•Building and managing reliable subcontractor networks throughout Europe

•Driving standardisation and process optimisation through the ADAPTUS platform

•Translating our European ambitions into a scalable project organisation
 

Once you have demonstrated clear leadership, organisational impact and operational excellence, your responsibilities will expand to Chief Operating Officer.

As COO, you will take responsibility for a broader operational organisation of approximately 22 employees on the ABN payroll, complemented by an extensive network of subcontractors responsible for project execution. Your scope will include projects and service, including maintenance, validation and operational customer support. You will develop service into a profitable activity within our Cleanroom-as-a-Service strategy and connect projects and service into one seamless customer lifecycle.

The transition to Chief Operating Officer is based on demonstrated leadership, organisational impact and operational excellence. For the right candidate, this progression is expected within approximately six to eighteen months.

You combine strong leadership skills with genuine technical depth.

HVAC holds no secrets for you. You understand air handling, pressure cascades, cooling loads and control technology well enough to challenge BIM specialists, work preparation teams, project managers, site managers, automation experts, validation specialists and subcontractors on content.

You also bring:

•At least ten years of experience in complex technical projects at customer sites

•Several years of experience in a senior leadership role

•Experience managing managers and multidisciplinary technical teams, rather than only operational teams

•Proven greenfield experience in another European country

•Hands-on experience sourcing, contracting and managing local subcontractors abroad

•A technical master’s degree or equivalent experience

•Fluency in Dutch and English; French or German is an advantage

•A structural willingness to travel across Europe

•An entrepreneurial, hands-on and highly result-driven mindset
 

Experience in cleanrooms, pharmaceuticals, biotech, laboratories, food production or high-tech environments is a strong asset.

Above all, you are a builder. You do not wait for the perfect structure — you create it.

Scope

jobs.occupation: Field Sales Manager - Belgium and the Netherlands
jobs.description:
Introduction
 

At Ekwip, our goal is simple: 
help local retail thrive internationally.
 

A sports shop in Namur, a bookshop in Ghent or a pet store in Rotterdam may have 
20–40% of its inventory sitting unsold, tying up cash and losing value. Ekwip takes care of this stock from end to end and sells it online across Europe through major marketplaces.
 

Retailers keep their store, identity and existing operations without having to become e-commerce experts.
 

The model is proven: steady monthly growth, no customer churn since launch and partnerships underway with major distributors. After a strong start in French-speaking Belgium, Ekwip is now expanding into Flanders and the Netherlands.
 

The pitch takes 90 seconds and the sales cycle is measured in days, not quarters. With 
more than 150,000 independent retailers across Europe, the opportunity is to sign hundreds of customers every year.
 

About the Role
 

You will lead 
business development from A to Z, working directly with Ekwip’s three co-founders.
 

Independent and specialised retailers
 
 

• Identify and target retailers in sports, fashion, footwear, pet care, home, toys and books 

• Build your own pipeline through cold calling, store visits, networking and trade fairs 

• Manage qualification, negotiation and closing 

• Organise your prospecting by region with a strong focus on efficiency and results  

Distributors and industrial wholesalers
 
 

• Identify the most relevant partners 

• Define the right approach and activate new opportunities 

• Lead negotiations and close strategic agreements 

• Develop partnerships where 
one agreement can unlock an entire network of stores  

Market insights and performance
 
 

• Act as Ekwip’s eyes and ears in the market 

• Share customer needs, recurring objections and local market practices 

• Feed insights directly into the product roadmap 

• Continuously manage your pipeline and performance  

Growth opportunities
 

Ekwip’s medium-term ambition is to build a commercial team in each country, with Business Developers and Account Managers.
 

You will be the first building block of this structure. 
Strong performance can lead to a management role, where you will recruit, train and lead your own local sales team.
 

Your Profile
 
 

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Sales or a related field 

• Fluent Dutch is essential, as this is the main market to develop; French and English are needed 

• A successful first experience in B2B sales, with proven results 

• Valid driving licence  

What we are looking for
 
 

• A true hunter mindset: you are comfortable with cold outreach and know how to build a pipeline from scratch 

• Strong autonomy: you manage your territory like your own business 

• Genuine curiosity for retail: you listen as much as you sell 

• A structured and methodical approach to pipeline management 

• The motivation to build in a fast-paced, demanding and pragmatic environment 

• Experience in retail, SaaS or marketplaces is a strong advantage
